flows.name: Multi-agent review (parallel + HITL)
flows.description: Triage → Path A runs repo-ops + sec-audit in parallel (or Path B FinOps) → HITL approve / reject / re-route → synthesize. Demonstrates parallel execution, tools on each agent node, and reviewer RBAC.
flows.demoPrompt: Review our AKS + Terraform stack for security issues and open PRs in contoso/agent-flow-azure. Check package requests for CVEs.

flows.name: Security incident (parallel findings + HITL)
flows.description: Triage → parallel sec-audit (cve-lookup tool) + repo-ops (repo-metrics tool) → join → security HITL → remediation brief. Best demo for tool chips on nodes and SecurityAuditor HITL.
flows.demoPrompt: Security incident: possible CVE in package urllib3 version 1.26.5 affecting contoso/platform-api. Assess severity and draft remediation.

flows.name: FinOps spend approval (HITL budget)
flows.description: Triage → FinOps analyst with cost-estimator tool → HITL budget approve/reject with notes → executive synthesize. Demonstrates Admin-only agent + structured HITL input.
flows.demoPrompt: Estimate monthly cost for APIM Consumption, Functions Y1, Cosmos serverless, Key Vault, and Foundry tokens for our agent platform. Cap recommendation at $50/mo.
